name: node-c
description: An end-to-end NodeJS framework for building DDD apps on top of NestJS.

scripts.build:clean:all: npm run build:clean --workspace=packages/nestjs-pino && npm run build:clean --workspace=packages/core && npm run build:clean --workspace=packages/data-rdb && npm run build:clean --workspace=packages/data-typeorm && npm run build:clean --workspace=packages/data-clickhouse && npm run build:clean --workspace=packages/data-redis && npm run build:clean --workspace=packages/domain-iam && npm run build:clean --workspace=packages/domain-iam-okta && npm run build:clean --workspace=packages/api-http && npm run build:clean --workspace=packages/api-rest && npm run build:clean --workspace=apps/test
scripts.clean-dependencies: rm -rf node_modules && rm -f package-lock.json && rm -rf **/*/node_modules && rm -f **/*/package-lock.json
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint --workspace=packages/core && npm run lint --workspace=packages/data-rdb && npm run lint --workspace=packages/data-typeorm && npm run lint --workspace=packages/data-clickhouse && npm run lint --workspace=packages/data-redis && npm run lint --workspace=packages/domain-iam && npm run lint --workspace=packages/domain-iam-okta && npm run lint --workspace=packages/api-http && npm run lint --workspace=packages/api-rest && npm run lint --workspace=apps/test
scripts.lint:all:parallel: npm run lint --workspace=packages/core & npm run lint --workspace=packages/data-rdb & npm run lint --workspace=packages/data-typeorm & npm run lint --workspace=packages/data-clickhouse & npm run lint --workspace=packages/data-redis & npm run lint --workspace=packages/domain-iam & npm run lint --workspace=packages/domain-iam-okta & npm run lint --workspace=packages/api-http & npm run lint --workspace=packages/api-rest & npm run lint --workspace=apps/test
